transsexual.definition:
n. a person who has undergone a sex change operation
n. a person whose sexual identification is entirely with the opposite sex
s. overwhelmingly desirous of being, or completely identifying with, the opposite sex

transsexualism.definition: n. condition in which a person assumes the identity and permanently acts the part of the gender opposite to his or her biological sex
transsexualism.translation: n. 变性,有易性癖,改变性别

transsexualist.translation: n. 有异性转化欲者,易性癖者

transsexuality.translation: n. 易性癖；改变性别；性欲错乱

transsexuals.definition:
plural of transsexual
n. a person who has undergone a sex change operation
n. a person whose sexual identification is entirely with the opposite sex
s. overwhelmingly desirous of being, or completely identifying with, the opposite sex
transsexuals.translation: (transsexual 的复数) n. 换性者

transshape.definition: v. t. To change into another shape or form; to transform.

transshaping.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Transshape

transshipment.definition: n. the transfer from one conveyance to another for shipment
transshipment.translation: n. 转船运输, 转载

transshipment center.translation: [网络] 毒品转运中心；转运站
